note: BH-1938 (BH-1511.1 slice): knobs read by bin/lane-alert.sh, the one alert path every detached orchestrator lane calls. It is a script, not a lane, so its knobs live in the registry's `libs` scope, keyed lib.lane-alert.<env lowercased>, applied by lane-alert.sh itself through lib_env_apply lane-alert.

libs.note: Resolved only on the --critical path with the orchestrator monitor off, inside a subshell so the gate's fail-closed exit 75 can never fail the caller.

knobs.note: The Telegram chat a --critical lane alert is DMed to while the orchestrator monitor is off (the operator's DM). A string, because a Telegram group chat id is negative (-100...). bin/lane-alert.sh has no literal for it: row > cached row > env > this default; with none of them it sends no DM and writes one ALERTS line.
